top_signals.title: U.S. Border Patrol finds 20 undocumented immigrants inside tractor-trailer at Texas truck stop
top_signals.summary:
The Aug. 20 operation occurred at an Edinburg, Texas, truck stop. Officials immediately took the driver into custody.

The post U.S. Border Patrol finds 20 undocumented immigrants inside tractor-trailer at Texas truck stop appeared first on FreightWaves.
